description: Search the SMS VERIFICATION service list — websites/apps a receive-only verification number can get a code for (Discord, Google, Telegram, ...). This is the SMS product line (no eSIM, nothing to install): the user gets a temporary phone number and reads the incoming code. Returns service names with their serviceId in [brackets]. If the target service is not listed, search "Other" — the catch-all works for any site. Next step: get_sms_service_countries.

query.description: Service name to search for (e.g. "Discord", "Google", "Tinder"). Omit to list the most popular services.

name: search_sms_services
